title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
recommendation: Both well above their nan% overall shooting clip (>=15 attempts each) -- load up P&R roll coverage and transition defense specifically; live with everything else.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
recommendation: Both well below their nan% overall shooting clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure their biggest turnover triggers
recommendation: Concentrate ball pressure on whichever action produces the most turnovers, rather than blanket full-court pressure.
